# Data

## Public data

```{r}
# shared data functions
source("./lib/processed_data_functions.R")

# phylogeny and profile data
load_processed_data(
  "./data/phylogeny/curated/phylogeny_profile_data.RDS",
  c(
    "tree_350",
    "major_sts",
    "selected_phylogeny_annotations",
    "resistance_variables",
    "mutation_variables"
  )
)
```

# Profile data

```{r}
load_processed_data(
  "./data/phylogeny/curated/threshold_profile_data.RDS",
  c(
    "selected_threshold_350_profiles",
    "threshold_350_cluster_levels"
  )
)
```

# Create tree

## Scales

```{r}
st_scale <- hues::iwanthue(n = length(major_sts))
st_scale_fill <- scale_fill_manual(
  breaks = c(major_sts, "Other ST"),
  values = c(st_scale, "white"),
  name = "Sequence type (ST)",
  guide = guide_legend(
    ncol = 6,
    title.position = "top",
    label.position = "right"
  )
)
cluster_scale <- scale_fill_manual(
  values = hues::iwanthue(
    n = length(threshold_350_cluster_levels)
  )
)
```

# 3k subset

## subsetted to threshold 350

```{r}
tree_obj_350 <- ggtree(tree_350)
```

## ST data

```{r}
col_width_adj <- 0.1
offset_step <- 0.0040625 * col_width_adj

st_column_350 <- selected_phylogeny_annotations %>%
  select(genome_id, st_track) %>%
  column_to_rownames("genome_id") %>%
  `colnames<-`("Major STs")

p0_350 <- gheatmap(
  tree_obj_350, st_column_350,
  color = NA, width = col_width_adj,
  colnames_position = "top", colnames_angle = 90,
  colnames_offset_y = 0.25, hjust = 0, font.size = 5.5
) + st_scale_fill + theme(legend.position = "none")

p0_350.1 <- p0_350 + ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()
```

## cluster data

```{r}
cluster_data_350 <- selected_threshold_350_profiles %>%
  select(genome_id, aa_cluster) %>%
  column_to_rownames("genome_id")

p1_350 <- gheatmap(
  p0_350.1,
  cluster_data_350 %>%
    select(aa_cluster) %>%
    `colnames<-`("Cluster"),
  width = col_width_adj, color = NA,
  colnames_position = "top", colnames_angle = 90,
  offset = offset_step, colnames_offset_y = 0.25,
  hjust = 0, font.size = 5.5
) + cluster_scale + theme(legend.position = "none")

p1_350.1 <- p1_350 + ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()
```

## resistance data

```{r}
resistance_data_350 <- selected_phylogeny_annotations %>%
  select(genome_id, all_of(resistance_variables)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("genome_id")

p3_350 <- gheatmap(
  p1_350.1,
  resistance_data_350,
  width = col_width_adj * length(resistance_variables),
  color = NA, colnames_position = "top", colnames_angle = 90,
  offset = offset_step * 2, colnames_offset_y = 0.25,
  hjust = 0, font.size = 5.5
) + phylogeny_resistance_fill + theme(legend.position = "none")

p3_350.1 <- p3_350 + ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()
```

## mutational data

```{r}
mutation_data_350 <- selected_phylogeny_annotations %>%
  select(genome_id, all_of(mutation_variables)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("genome_id")

mutation_variable_order <- dist(
  t(mutation_data_350),
  method = "binary"
) %>%
  hclust() %>%
  .$order

p4_350 <- gheatmap(
  p3_350.1,
  mutation_data_350 %>%
    select(all_of(rev(mutation_variables[mutation_variable_order]))) %>%
    `colnames<-`(gsub("_", " ", colnames(.))),
  width = col_width_adj * length(mutation_variables),
  color = NA, colnames_position = "top", colnames_angle = 90,
  offset = offset_step * 10, colnames_offset_y = 0.25,
  hjust = 0, font.size = 5.5
) + phylogeny_presence_fill + theme(legend.position = "none") + ylim(NA, 3400)
```

## add legend 

```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 10}
get_legend <- function(p) cowplot::get_legend(p + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

legend_st_plot <- ggplot(
  data.frame(
    st_track = factor(
      c(major_sts, "Other ST"),
      levels = c(major_sts, "Other ST")
    )
  ),
  aes(x = 1, y = st_track, fill = st_track)
) +
  geom_tile() +
  st_scale_fill +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.title.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),legend.key = element_rect(colour = c('black'))
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      ncol = 10,
      byrow = TRUE,
      title.position = "top",
      label.position = "right"
    )
  )

legend_res_plot <- ggplot(
  data.frame(Resistance = factor(resistance_levels, levels = resistance_levels)),
  aes(x = 1, y = Resistance, fill = Resistance)
) +
  geom_tile() +
  phylogeny_resistance_fill +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.title.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 6,
      byrow = TRUE,
      title.position = "top",
      label.position = "right"
    )
  )

legend_mut_plot <- ggplot(
  data.frame(Presence = factor(c(1, 0), levels = c(1, 0))),
  aes(x = 1, y = Presence, fill = Presence)
) +
  geom_tile() +
  phylogeny_presence_fill +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.title.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    legend.key = element_rect(colour='black')
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend( 
      nrow = 6,
      byrow = TRUE,
      title.position = "top",
      label.position = "right"
    )
  )

legend_st <- get_legend(legend_st_plot)
legend_res <- get_legend(legend_res_plot)
legend_mut <- get_legend(legend_mut_plot)

legend_row <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  legend_st,
  legend_res,
  legend_mut,
  nrow = 1,
  rel_widths = c(0.7, 0.15, 0.15)
)

# remove white space between phylo and legend
legend_row <- legend_row + theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = -25, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0)
  )

p5_350 <- cowplot::plot_grid(p4_350, legend_row, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.18)) + ylim(NA, 3400)

p5_350 
```
